storyCards.headline: Is It Love: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Mr. Mister's "Is It Love" reached #8 on the Billboard Hot 100. Mister and the third released from Welcome to the Real World.

The song peaked at number 8 on the Billboard Hot 100 in June 1986, being their last major hit in charts.

The song peaked at #8 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Is It Love was released in 1985.
